items.text: $\widehat C\simeq\operatorname{Top}(C)$ for $C$ ordered
O_x\subset O_y\iff x\le y;\quad \{O_x\}\ \text{a basis of the topology},\ \{O_x\}^\circ\simeq C
Sheaves on the space = presheaves on the basis $\{O_x\}$ = $\widehat C$: every presheaf is a sheaf, since a covering of $O_x$ contains $O_x$ itself ($x\in O_{x_i}\Rightarrow O_x\subset O_{x_i}$).
Converse: $X$ sober, $\operatorname{Top}(X)\simeq\widehat C$
$\widehat C$ has a conservative family of essential points. A point $x$ of $X$ is essential iff it has a smallest open neighbourhood $U_x$:
F_x=\varinjlim_{U\ni x}F(U)=F(U_x)
Conservative family of points $X'\subset X$ $\iff$ $X'$ is very dense: every non-empty locally closed subset of $X$ meets $X'$.
Necessary and sufficient: the essential points of $X$ form a very dense subset.
Localization
\mathcal E/S'\xrightarrow{\ j\ }\mathcal E,\qquad j^*(X)=X\times S'\ \ (\text{over } S')
$j^*$ commutes with direct limits and with all inverse limits (finite ones: inverse image; arbitrary: left adjoint $j_!$).
Localization morphism; $j^*$ the localization functor. A property is true locally if true after localizing to $S'$.
Subgroups and localization
G\ \text{group object of }\mathcal E;\quad BG=\{\text{objects of }\mathcal E\text{ with left } G\text{-action}\}
Bf\colon BG\to BG',\quad (Bf)^*(X)=X\ \text{with } G\text{ acting through } f
$H\subset G$ a subgroup. Claim: $BH\simeq BG/X$ for $X=G/H$, and $Bi$ becomes the localization morphism.
X=G/H\in BG\quad(G\ \text{acting by left translation})
$\Psi\colon BG/X\to BH$: for $E\to X$ equivariant, $e\colon\mathrm{pt}\to X$ the class of $1$ (stable under $H$):
\Psi(E)=E\times_X\{e\}\ \in BH
$\Phi\colon BH\to BG/X$: contracted product, $H$ acting on $G\times F$ by $h\cdot(g,f)=(gh^{-1},hf)$:
\Phi(F)=G\times^HF=(G\times F)/H\ \longrightarrow\ G/H=X
$G$ acts on $G\times^HF$ by left translation on $G$; $\Phi,\Psi$ quasi-inverse.
Compatibility: restriction $G\to H$ corresponds to $j^*$:
Z\in BG:\quad \Psi(Z\times X)=Z\ \text{with the action of } H\ \text{only}
$BH$ is a localization of $BG$ by $X\to e$: a covering, not a monomorphism.
Galois theory of coverings
$Z$ connected, locally connected, locally simply connected; $z\in Z$; $G=\pi_1(Z,z)$.
\{\text{coverings of } Z\}\ \xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\ BG,\qquad Z'\mapsto Z'_z\ \text{(fibre, with monodromy action)}
Universal covering $P\to Z$: connected, simply connected, with $\tilde z\in P_z$; $G=\operatorname{Aut}_Z(P)$.
E\mapsto P\times^GE\quad(\text{covering with fibre } E)
Subgroup $H\subset G$ $\leftrightarrow$ $G$-set $X$ transitive with a point $x$ $\leftrightarrow$ connected covering $Z'\to Z$ with a point $z'$ over $z$.
BG/X\ \simeq\ \{\text{étale coverings of } Z'\}\ \simeq\ BH,\qquad H=\pi_1(Z',z')
